main_text.p: qui ἀγρονόμος[?] fuisse, id est, foro rerum venalium praefuisse eos interpretatur: νομοφύλακες[?], quos in foro quoque curiam habuisse, Pausanias dicit, quorum tamen nulla in historiis usquam mentio, legum custodes, quod nomen arguit, operam dantes, ne leges latae diserperirent, aut oblivione obliterarentur, factisve abolerentur: cujus generis magistratum in Graeciae civitatibus usitatum fuisse bono publico, Cicero de legibus disputans testis est. His vero clariores fuere, & in historiis celebrati harmostae, hippagretae, polemarchi, prodici, Pythii, proxeni. Quorum celeberrimi ἀστυνόμοι[?] domi in comitiis populi creati, peregre cum imperio ad civitates socias aut bello devictas ad clavum sessuri mittebantur. Nam, ut dictum a nobis alibi, in more Lacones habebant, in civitatibus quas aut armis superassent, aut quovis modo imperio adjecissent suo, relicta iis reliqua libertate oligarchias instituere, & viris decem, pluribusve, quod erat rarius, in senatum descriptis, rempublicam earum regendam permittere. Istis vero decurrionibus ex civitate sua praefectum addebant, qui rerum summae praesiderent, & conservando statui instituto, & retinendas[?]

page.notes: Greek words are read from a small, slightly blurred print and marked [?]. "retinendas" is the last word on the page and is partly cut off at the foot, so it is marked [?]. Catchword "nend." at the foot right is uncertain. Signature "T 5" is read from the foot left. The right margin has ghosted marks (for example beside "Lacones") that are show-through from the other side and are not transcribed. The Greek "ἀγρονόμος" and "ἀστυνόμοι" readings are doubtful; the letters should be checked against the scan.
